lang.name: English
app.tagline: The SCADA that builds itself and warns you in advance
empty.insights: Process is normal — the AI sees no deviations
alarms.title: Current alarms
ml.process_event: Mode change: {count} signals deviated at once — {tags}
ml.stuck: {tag}: value {value} {unit} has not changed for {seconds} s — looks like a stuck sensor
ml.correlation: Signal relationships are broken. Main contributors: {top}
hint.spike: A single spike usually needs no action. If it repeats, check the sensor cable, shielding and grounding.
hint.event: Many signals changed at once: equipment start/stop or a mode change. Make sure it was intended.
hint.drift: Compare with a portable instrument or a neighbouring sensor — calibration may be due, or wear is developing.
hint.stuck: The sensor may have frozen or lost power — check the 4–20 mA loop and the input module.
hint.correlation: Each signal is within range, but their relationship is broken — typical for leaks, blockages and breaks that threshold alarms cannot see.
hint.forecast: There is time before the alarm: reduce the load, prepare the standby unit or call maintenance.
ml.model_desc: Learns how plant signals move together and detects broken relationships that threshold alarms cannot see.
ml.how.1: A streaming C++ detector per tag: spikes, slow drift and stuck sensors — O(1) memory per tag.
ml.how.2: Holt forecasting estimates the rate of change and tells how many minutes remain before an alarm.
ml.how.3: A PCA model catches broken relationships between signals and explains which tags are responsible.
gen.title: Process view generator
gen.desc: Paste the YAML configuration of any plant — the operator interface is built automatically: units along the process flow, elements by signal type.
gen.ok: Generated: {areas} units, {tags} tags, {alarms} alarm limits, {ml} tags monitored by AI
demo.title: Demo scenarios
demo.desc: Inject a fault into the pump station model and watch the AI notice it before the threshold alarms do.
fault.bearing_wear.desc: Vibration, motor current and bearing temperature slowly increase.
fault.bearing_wear.watch: A predicted vibration alarm appears minutes before the real one.
fault.leak.desc: Some water bypasses the flow meter; the controller hides it by speeding up the pump.
fault.leak.watch: Threshold alarms stay silent — only the PCA model catches the broken relationship.
fault.sensor_drift.desc: The bearing sensor reading creeps up although the real temperature is stable.
fault.sensor_drift.watch: A “Drift” insight and the bearing_temp contribution on the AI insights page.
fault.stuck_sensor.desc: The sensor keeps reporting the same value.
fault.stuck_sensor.watch: A “Stuck sensor” insight appears in ~15 s.
fault.current_spikes.desc: Impulse noise in the motor current measurement.
fault.current_spikes.watch: Spikes are marked with violet dots on the current trend.
fault.pump_trip.desc: The pump has stopped — the tank level starts to fall.
fault.pump_trip.watch: The predicted level alarm shows how many minutes remain before the tank runs dry.
